newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber unchanged in featureless trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber unchanged in featureless trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade March SIR20 offer prices were unchanged in featureless trading on Tuesday as players stayed out of a market lacking consumer demand and fresh fundamentals, dealers said.
"It's quiet and I don't hear of any fresh deals," said one dealer. "Market sentiment remains poor, mainly because of the winter in the U.S., which causes very low demand," he added.
Dealers said March SIR20 offer prices were unchanged at 53.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang. They said offer prices stayed at 53.25-53.50 fob Medan and Surabaya.
The U.S. is Indonesia's main rubber importer.
